title: Rating summary and distribution
guidance: Replace the disliked warning-like brown distribution bars with a restrained, distinguishable count series in both themes. Numeric ratings/counts stay explicit; final color judgment remains human.

decisions.title: Neutral count series with explicit values
decisions.reason: All rating bars use one restrained neutral role; counts and overall score remain numeric. Gold stars retain their separate rating meaning. No warning-colored gradient.

decisions.title: Color remains provisional
decisions.reason: Bar/track contrast is measured3.87:1 Light and5.93:1 Dark. These measurements do not grant human aesthetic approval.

parameters.name: Canonical bar roles
parameters.description: Light bar #69798C; Dark #A6B3C3. Tracks inherit the field surface; the actual values shown by this viewer come from the theme.

parameters.name: Distribution geometry
parameters.description: 2rem label / flexible bar /1.5rem count; .625rem gaps; .5rem bar height; tabular numeric counts.

status.visual: Independent normal composition across all94 named states in both themes/mobile/desktop, plus selected native child/parent/page and stress/live scopes. Individual captured-only pixels remain unvisited; see1.9 coverage.
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment
